outcome: Timing of delivery in vasa previa
cohort: International panel of 68 experts on vasa previa
finding: An international expert panel reached a consensus on 26 statements regarding the definition, screening, clinical management, and timing of delivery in vasa previa.
mod_finding: The expert panel reached a consensus that asymptomatic patients with vasa previa should be delivered by scheduled cesarean delivery between 35 and 37 weeks of gestation.
